facts.text: Features become mandatory starting from specific release versions when they transition from optional to automatically enabled.
Generally available as of 2026 release wave 2 (version 29) for features listed as mandatory.
Check the Feature Management page to see the mandatory version in the Automatically enabled from field before a feature becomes non-disableable.
When a feature becomes mandatory, it no longer appears in Feature Management and cannot be disabled.
Six features are mandatory in version 29 and can no longer be controlled in Feature Management.
Advanced Tell Me and semantic similarity search were delayed from version 29 to version 30 as mandatory.
Some mandatory features apply to specific country localizations such as Italy VAT settlements and US 1099 forms.
